missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Вино' is the neuter nominative subject. 'Вкусное' is the agreeing neuter adjective, and 'очень' intensifies the praise.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Вино' is the accusative direct object of 'люблю'. As an inanimate neuter noun it keeps the same form, and 'красное' agrees in the neuter accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Вина' is the genitive of 'вино', required after 'нет'. 'Красного' agrees in the neuter genitive, marking absence.
Strategic focus: Partitive genitive. 'Вина' is the genitive of 'вино' expressing a portion to be poured. 'В мой бокал' gives the accusative destination of the pouring.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Вином' is the neuter instrumental of 'вино', required by 'наслаждаемся'. 'Хорошим' agrees in the neuter instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Вине' is the prepositional of 'вино' after 'в'. 'Этом' agrees in the neuter prepositional, and 'мало сахара' uses the genitive of quantity.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Вино' is the neuter nominative subject of 'стоит'. 'На столе' gives the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Genitive after quantity. 'Вина' is the genitive of 'вино' after the measure word 'бутылку'. 'Белого' agrees in the neuter genitive. A natural ordering phrase.

missions.phrase: Грузинские вина известны во всём мире.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Вина' is the nominative plural of 'вино' as the subject. 'Грузинские' agrees in the plural, and 'во всём мире' gives the prepositional scope.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Вина' is the accusative plural of the inanimate neuter 'вино', the object of 'попробовали'. 'Разные местные' agree in the plural.
